fields.notes: PTP's protocol-level DFT surface is the data sets via Management messages (currentDS / portDS / parentDS), the raw timestamps and correctionField, and the 1PPS/ToD output for external measurement. Chip-level JTAG / scan / BIST remain SoC-integrator concerns; conformance is established by IEEE 1588 / 802.1AS testing.
fields.ic_name: IEEE 1588 Precision Time Protocol (PTP) Clock Synchronization Engine (PTPv2 / IEEE 802.1AS)

in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Read/write defaultDS / currentDS / portDS / parentDS for monitoring and configuration.

in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Raw T1..T4 and Transparent-Clock residence observability.

out_of_band_test_facilities: IEEE 1588 / IEEE 802.1AS conformance and interoperability testing.
